findings.message: 14 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Websites · AI agents · Digital products" above "Customers check you online before they p"; "Websites · AI agents · Digital products" above "What are they seeing? What are they seei"; "01 · Trust" above "People trust you before they talk to you"; "02 · Found" above "Customers find you, not your competitor."; "03 · Paid" above "Enquiries arrive while you sleep."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 2 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The margins differ: 48px on the left, 90px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 6 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 820px at 11448px; 1064px at 12416px; 732px at 16092px; 452px at 4104px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (390px, 432px, 48px, 112px, 592px, 784px, 548px); the three most used hold only 43% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Be the name people find, and the one they choose" (screen 8, 100% hidden); "Turn your website into your best salesperson." (screen 8, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 26px from the left edge but only to 66px from the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 9827px of nothing between: "Book your free call"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Clear packages. No surprises. Clear packages. No" → 3 lines (8 words, 31.6px); "Working with us feels different. Working with us" → 3 lines (10 words, 31.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
